data: Apple's net income was $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022 and $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024, a decrease of about 6.1% (roughly $6.1 billion) over the two years. Fiscal 2023 net income was $97.0 billion, so the decline came in two steps rather than a single drop. These figures are from Apple's annual 10-K filings.
